findings.claim: 7006 reached success radius and subsequently left; not simply failure to find the initial target room.
findings.evidence: oracle_success=1; new entry node3 [-14.1348,3.15184,6.77164] is near old successful endpoint [-13.7051,3.15184,6.90710]; later 3.06m +.75m traversals enter opposite bedroom as visible in waypoint images.
findings.limitation: Oracle metric is offline diagnosis only, never planner input. It does not identify the exact successful timestep.

findings.claim: Automatic VLA memory injection can supply an older segment from a different task after intervening movement.
findings.evidence: AgenticTasks.policy_instruction always selects latest caption. 7006 final request atnode4 injects edge2->3 caption from task3;4132 task5 uses task3 caption through six intervening segments.
findings.limitation: Mechanism and inputs verified; causal navigation effect needs ablation.

findings.claim: Changing local instruction within same task retains old visual anchor unless reset_context is requested.
findings.evidence: 7006 task4-frame46 used for Move to foot / Turn around and walk / Move forward;4132 task5-frame149 used for six different instructions.
findings.limitation: Continuation may correctly retain history; do not reset indiscriminately. Need define instruction reference frame and compare.

findings.claim: Planner image pruning is FIFO over complete tool-feedback turns, not execution evidence importance.
findings.evidence: ContextWindow.build advances start exponentially. Projection preserves plan/latest caption but not earlier task-boundary images or per-task accepted evidence.
findings.limitation: 7006 latest endpoint images were present; cannot attribute its final error just to missing images.
